Aperte F8 para configurar o mod, ou abra: Press F8 to configure the mod, or open Minecraft Options and select NVVision.
Português (Brasil). Altera apenas o idio: Portuguese (Brazil). Changes only NVVision's language. No hardware impact.

Controla a distância visual de entidades: Controls entity drawing distance and local effects. Off preserves the game; balanced reduces distant details; economy reduces more. Does not change machines or server ticks.
Controla a proteção de memória ou abre a: Controls memory protection or opens FerriteCore settings. RAM savings may increase CPU work. FerriteCore changes require a restart.
Reduz detalhes visuais do Create quando: Reduces Create visuals when installed. Original preserves visuals; economy profiles reduce particles and distant details. Does not change machine behavior.
Escolhe a reconstrução da imagem. Linear: Selects image reconstruction. Linear costs less; sharpened filtering uses more samples; bicubic and FSR 1 require more GPU work. Extra sharpening may create halos.
Controla a resolução interna. 100% prese: Controls internal resolution. 100% preserves native image quality; lower values reduce pixels and GPU work but can blur details. Dynamic mode adjusts scale within your limits.
Reduz efeitos visuais. Desativado preser: Reduces visual effects. Off preserves effects; higher levels reduce particle count or distance. Does not change weather or world rules.
Limita a área que recebe ticks no mundo: Limits the ticked area in local worlds. Lower values can reduce CPU work but reduce simulation range. Servers keep their own rules; suspended with Create/Flywheel.
Controla o alcance de desenho ou carrega: Controls drawing or loading range. Lower values reduce work and distant details; higher values require more CPU, GPU and memory. Compatibility safeguards remain active.
Define uma meta ou limite de quadros. Li: Sets a frame target or cap. Lower caps reduce CPU and GPU work; higher targets may increase power use. The background cap applies only when the window loses focus.
Controla texturas e mipmaps. Níveis maio: Controls textures and mipmaps. Higher levels smooth distant textures and use more GPU memory. Apply reloads resources and may briefly pause; Import adds the selected pack.
Controla qualidade visual ou preparação: Controls visual quality or shader preparation. Higher quality needs more GPU work; reducing shadows, clouds and effects can reduce rendering work. Prepare or Apply may pause during reload.
Reduz movimento e efeitos da câmera. É u: Reduces camera movement and effects. This is a visual preference; performance impact is usually small and depends on the shader.
Mede o tempo de renderização da GPU sem: Measures GPU rendering time without waiting for it. Helps the dynamic controller; does not measure usage percentage or guarantee more FPS.
Restaura os valores indicados. Confira a: Restores the indicated values. Review options before applying: previous settings may use more or fewer resources.
Abre, importa, exporta ou analisa o recu: Opens, imports, exports or analyzes the indicated resource. May temporarily use disk and CPU; does not increase FPS on its own.
Escolhe ou aplica um conjunto de ajustes: Selects or applies a group of settings. Off preserves values; economy prioritizes fewer details; balanced mixes cost and quality; quality preserves more details. Review individual controls.
Aplica os valores selecionados. A carga: Applies selected values. Workload depends on the chosen settings; reloads may briefly pause the game.
Enables or disables NVVision adjustments. On allows selected features; Off preserves native rendering according to compatibility safeguards.
Abre ou alterna a opção indicada. Desati: Opens or cycles the indicated option. Off preserves original behavior; higher values may increase detail or visual reduction depending on the control.
